title: The best Athan, Azkar app
review: Salam Alikum, first there is not a lot of ads, you will see mini ads at the bottom of the page but it leaves after you stay on the app for like 30sec and only from time to time will there be a pop up ad. One big critique I have about this app is the sometimes the ads have women one them and they are not Muslim. One of the best thing about this app this the widgets that it has available in IOS. But the fact that you can remove the ads for 1.99 a month is a steal. I Like how smooth the app is, no bugs and shutting off randomly. Gives you a lot of editing control. I love the app and May Allah bless and guide the people who made this app.

title: ads obstruct the flow of prayer now
review:
The developer tried with the app, but it has left a lot to be desired. 

The app has so much more than athkar, with duas, morning evening waking and sleeping athkar, quran and some prayer times with recitation, it's like a one-stop shop. 
it has allowed me to be more fluent and consistent in my athkar and i appreciate it. 

however all good things are temporary and come to pass. the transliteration is fine, but many of the athkar are left without tanween and such and as someone who isnt an arabic native speaker it's hard to say the azkar without them, along with the fact there there are several different fonts that make reading confusing. 

i'm a long time user of the app, and back when it was first out i seemed to remember the ads being much more subtle and a way for the developer to fund the app. 

it seems the app is now how the developer makes their living, as I can barely navigate the app without a bunch of innapropriate generic ads flooding my field of view. 
recently ads have also began to come midroll in the duas and athkar as well. i'll be deep into a prayer session when it is disrupted with ads trying to get me to sign up to their credit recovery program (i dont use credit??)

if there was an option for a one-time purchase, despite the developer's flagrant transgressions, i would've purchased it; however, there only seem to be subscription plans that would drain some poor bloke's wealthh, so I'll pass on investing in this app for now, inshallah.

title: Bugged widgets!!!!!!!!!!!!
review: At first glance I loved this app because the widgets are wonderful and you can choose from a beautiful selection of adhans. But the Home Screen widget is so bugged - it often disappears and neglects to notify me of prayer times. I'm new to Islam, so I'm not used to thinking of prayer as a part of my day yet and I'm trying to build the habit. So on days when I'm at work and busy, too busy to stay on top of prayer times on my own, and the widget disappears, I sometimes miss prayer windows altogether. This bug is extremely, extremely inconvenient and judging that there are a number of other similar reviews, it's a wonder it hasn't been fixed yet.
